module: "topCenter" app container (top-center of the interface: arrowGPS, rally, drift, drag, pointsBar, speedTargetBar, flashMessage, countdown, moveOff; UI trigger setTopCenterAppVisibility). It delegates visibility to ui_appContainers and adds a flash message queue (event TopCenterAppsFlashMessage), scenario countdown handling and the speed target of the speedTargetBar. A modder mostly uses it to show a flash message or a speed target.
notes: All the visibility functions (setAppVisibility, showApp, hideApp, toggleApp, hideAllApps, getVisibleApps, getAvailableApps) are simple pass-throughs to ui_appContainers.
setContainerContext, getContainerContext, resetContainerContext and getAvailableContexts are deprecated (warning only if setVerboseLogging(true)): a "context" equals a single visible app.
clearSpeedTarget only resets the local value to nil: it sends nothing to the interface, unlike setSpeedTarget.
onGameplayFlashMessage ignores the message if the matching app (drift or drag) is not visible at the time of the call.
The duration of a queued message is messageData[1][2] (3 s by default); it is counted down in simulation time (dtSim), whereas showFlashMessage counts down in real time (dtReal).
The queue is limited to 50 messages: beyond that, the oldest is removed.
The countdown is detected when a scenario message starts with a number or with the key 'ui.scenarios.go'; the countdown app is then shown and hidden after the "go" ttl (field M._countdownHideTimer).

hideAllApps.desc: Hides all apps of the container (via ui_appContainers).

showApp.desc: Shows an app of the container.

hideApp.desc: Hides an app of the container.

toggleApp.desc: Toggles the visibility of an app of the container.

getVisibleApps.desc: Lists the visible apps of the container (via ui_appContainers).

getAvailableApps.desc: Returns a copy of the container's declared apps with their visibility.

setContainerContext.desc: Deprecated. Hides all apps then shows only the app named by context (if context is nil, everything is hidden).

getContainerContext.desc: Deprecated: returns the first visible app in the list (order not guaranteed if there are several).

setSpeedTarget.desc: Stores the active speed target and sends it to the interface via guihooks.trigger('TechDriverTrainingSpeedBarTarget', data) for the speedTargetBar.

data.desc: Target data, passed as is to the interface (structure not defined here).

getSpeedTarget.desc: Returns the last stored speed target.

clearSpeedTarget.desc: Forgets the stored speed target (without notifying the interface).

setDebug.desc: Enables a small "TopCenter App Containers Debug" ImGui window (queue size, active message).

setVerboseLogging.desc: Enables deprecation warnings and logs of invalid messages.

showFlashMessage.desc: Shows a single flash message, shows the flashMessage app and sends {msg, ttl, big} on the TopCenterAppsFlashMessage event. The message is kept for ttl so that an app mounted late can retrieve it.

getActiveFlashMessage.desc: Used by the HUD app to catch up on a message sent before it was mounted: returns the active message with the remaining ttl, or nil if there is none or if the flashMessage app is hidden.

clearMessagesFromSource.desc: Removes from the queue the messages of a given source (drift, drag…); if the current message comes from it, moves on to the next or hides flashMessage.

clearAllFlashMessages.desc: Empties the queue, the current message and the active message, and hides the flashMessage app.

onGameplayFlashMessage.desc: Hook: gameplay flash message. Only accepts the sources 'drift' and 'drag', and only if the app of the same name is visible; then queues the message and starts the next one.

onScenarioFlashMessage.desc: Hook: scenario flash message. Shows flashMessage if the list is not empty, and countdown if an item starts with a number or 'ui.scenarios.go' (in the latter case, hides countdown after the ttl).

onScenarioFlashMessageClear.desc: Hook: hides the flashMessage app when the scenario clears its messages.

onScenarioNotRunning.desc: Hook: hides flashMessage when no scenario is running.

onUpdate.desc: Frame hook: counts down the active message, advances the message queue, handles the deferred hiding of the countdown and draws the debug window.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: registers the topCenter container and its nine apps (all hidden at start).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: empties the queue and the active messages.
